## Pull request overview

Adds a `preview` runtime mode to the kernel context protocol in `@objectstack/spec`, introducing a dedicated `previewMode` configuration for demo/marketplace scenarios and documenting it with tests and examples.

**Changes:**
- Extended `RuntimeMode` with `preview` and added `PreviewModeConfigSchema` plus optional `previewMode` on `KernelContextSchema`.
- Added unit tests for preview mode parsing/defaults and validation edge cases.
- Updated example configs and docs/READMEs to describe how to run and configure preview mode.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/context.zod.ts | Adds `preview` runtime mode and defines `PreviewModeConfigSchema`; extends `KernelContextSchema` with optional `previewMode`. |
| packages/spec/src/kernel/context.test.ts | Adds tests for preview mode acceptance, config defaults, and validation errors. |
| examples/app-host/objectstack.config.ts | Adds a `PreviewHostExample` stack configuration demonstrating preview mode usage. |
| examples/app-host/README.md | Documents how to run app-host in preview mode and lists `PreviewModeConfig` properties. |
| examples/README.md | Mentions preview mode support and adds quick-start command for `OS_MODE=preview`. |
| content/docs/references/kernel/context.mdx | Updates reference docs to include `preview` and `previewMode`, plus a `PreviewModeConfig` section. |
</details>
